output.summary: Approve re-enabling CodeWiki Pi tools for the CodeWiki source checkout after the self-dogfood gate passed.

approvedRows.question: Should CodeWiki self-dogfood be re-enabled in the CodeWiki source checkout now?
approvedRows.currentState: The self-dogfood re-enable gate is codified and passed: npm run test:self-dogfood-ready completed successfully; TRACE-self-dogfood-reenable-gate-v1 has valid decision, planning, and implementation records; latest content proof matched; .pi/settings.json loads CodeWiki through the project-local package path ..; no shim/global mutation path is used.
approvedRows.desiredState: Repo operating guidance allows supervised CodeWiki wiki_* tool use inside this checkout, starting with read-only wiki_state, then preview-mode wiki_decide/wiki_plan/wiki_implement before guarded append. Limits remain: expected-byte/sequence guards, project-local install, no unattended worker start, no auto-merge, and no auto-publish.
approvedRows.rationale: The documented safety gate has passed and the user explicitly approved re-enable. Keeping the remaining supervision limits preserves false-pass resistance while allowing CodeWiki to dogfood its own loops.
approvedRows.userImpact: Agents can now use CodeWiki tools in this repository under the documented supervised constraints.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers must continue running the gate after safety-sensitive changes and keep mutation-capable tools guarded.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Guidance, tests, and trace proof must be updated before using mutation-capable tools for new work.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Gate passed, install path is project-local, and remaining limits are explicit.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: User explicitly asked to re-enable CodeWiki if safe.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Enables CodeWiki to validate its own workflow with real dogfood while preserving safety gates.
agentAssessment.rationale: Readiness, package, mutation, external lifecycle, failure, audit, and lab gates passed.
concerns: Current session developer prompt may still contain the old disabled policy until context refresh; use repo guidance for future turns once this trace lands.

approvedRows.currentPain: Repo docs still say to use core facades until the gate passes even though the gate has now passed and the user approved re-enable.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Repo guidance says supervised CodeWiki Pi-tool dogfood is enabled and tests guard the remaining constraints.
approvedRows.successSignal: Readiness tests pass, trace validates, content proof matches, and first post-enable wiki_state read is possible.
nonGoals: Do not remove expected-byte or sequence guards.
Do not add a .pi/extensions shim or global install dependency.
